dialogues.speaker: Ikeda Soushirou
dialogues.text: Oh, hello... Um... Who are you again?

dialogues.speaker: Ikeda Soushirou
dialogues.text: Are you... one of Takayuki's kids? You don't look like one of them...

dialogues.speaker: Ikeda Soushirou
dialogues.text: I am a Kujou Clan retainer. Of course I remember every member of his family. Takayuki is a gifted boy with big aspirations. He'll be somebody one day, that's for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Ikeda Soushirou
dialogues.text: I don't know if his grades are still as good as before though, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Ikeda Soushirou
dialogues.text: Aye. Be careful on the road, kiddo.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem to have mistaken me for someone else...

dialogues.speaker: Ikeda Soushirou
dialogues.text: Eh, you're not one of the Kujou Clan kids, huh... Indeed, I have been working for his clan my whole life. I don't think I've ever seen anyone like you...

dialogues.speaker: Ikeda Soushirou
dialogues.text: Ah, I must really be getting too old... A word advice for you, child. The younger you are, the more conscientious you should be. Don't make the wrong decision.

dialogues.speaker: Ikeda Soushirou
dialogues.text: Yeah, youngster, studying is of the utmost importance. You need to study hard and train hard. Only one who is a fine warrior and scholar both can become the backbone of the Kujou Clan.

dialogues.speaker: Ikeda Soushirou
dialogues.text: If you asked me, the youngsters from the Kujou Clan should learn from Sara! Sara excels at martial arts and is very loyal to the Kujou Clan. Although she was adopted by Takayuki, she is still far more reliable than many actual clan members, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Ikeda Soushirou
dialogues.text: That's it... To grow taller, you need to listen to the advice of your elders.

dialogues.speaker: Ikeda Soushirou
dialogues.text: I think you kids will like these snacks. Eat them along the way. Walk slowly, and be careful not to fall.
